skills.name: Moonlit Flower (月下花)
skills.line: You'll never find happiness like this!
skills.description:
This is your bond with a goddess' wrath!
Enmusubi no Kami wields a moonlit flower to summon a crushing mark of bonds to attack a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

upgrades.text: Also increases her move bar by 20%.

skills.name: Flower Moon (緋色花月)
skills.line: I'm happy to be single. But you two must get together!
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
At the start of another ally's turn, Enmusubi no Kami grants them 1 Knot of a random type (max 4 types). If Knot they receive is the same type as the one granted to the last ally that took an action (other than Enmusubi no Kami), a match is formed. Then 1 onibi will be immediately gain and Enmusubi no Kami will gain 1 layer of Fateful Bond. If a match is not formed, she will gain 1 layer of Frustration. 
;
:
;Fateful Bond (縁)
:
:'''General, Mark''': Max 7 layers. Upon using Blessed Bond, each layer of Fateful Bond increases damage dealt for allies by 5% and increases Enmusubi no Kami's healing by 1%.
;Frustration (怒った)
:
:'''Common, Mark''': Max 5 layers. When Enmusubi no Kami gains 5 layers of Frustration, all layers are consumed to dispel or remove all control effects on her and decreases move bar of all enemies by 25%. She loses 2 layers when a match is formed.
;Remove
: Removes non-dispellable control effects such as Deep Freeze, Transform, Daze and Provoke.

skills.name: Blessed Bond (神賜良縁)
skills.description: Enmusubi no Kami blesses an ally, granting them Shelter and also boosts the morale of all non-summoned allies, increasing their damage dealt by 40%, lasts for 1 turn. Then restores the HP for all allies by 9% of her max HP. ;Flame Reignited (前世の縁) :'''General, Mark''': At the end of the blessed ally's turn, they are granted a new turn. Skills used in this new turn costs -3 onibi. ;Shelter : :Negates all controlling effects inflicted by a single skill.

upgrades.text: When she has at least 1 layer of Fateful Bond, 50% of the excess healing will be converted to a shield.
When she has at least 3 layers of Fateful Bond, increases SPD for all allies' by 30.
When she has at least 7 layers of Fateful Bond, the blessed ally is granted Flame Reignited and she gains Shelter.
'''Upper Hand''': At the start of battle, she automatically gains Shelter.

bio.condition: Increase Enmusubi no Kami's level to 30.
Increase Enmusubi no Kami's skills 8 times.
In PVN zones, successfully form 99 bonds.
